title: The Meow Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including,…
description: The Meow Gallery plugin for WordPress up to and including version 5.5.4 has an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users with author-level access or higher to enumerate and read metadata of all private and draft posts on the site, including those authored by other users. The metadata exposed includes post ID, title, date, author, and status.
